Glance 2026.09.14 adds live log previews and improves preview responsiveness and memory usage.

## Highlights

- Monitor plain-text files with incremental updates, a configurable refresh interval, and optional scrolling to the latest content.
- Highlight log timestamps, severity levels, and field names using extensible rules.
- Hover over JSON nodes to see their full paths, such as `root.data.items[3]`.
- Keep the current preview intact when Everything refreshes an unchanged selection.
- Use less memory for image previews and panorama playback, with smoother returns to proxy video.
- Improve PDF switching and thumbnails, CAD rendering, and cancellation of obsolete preview work.
- Bound resource usage for large PSD files and archive metadata scans, and preserve preview files used by other running instances.
